Since the sub was recently transferred to my control, and I've left the sticky up long enough to (I hope) make that clear to all active users, I have a question for all. Do we approve of the rules put in place by the previous leadership?

Subverse Rules:

  1. Memes, image macros, and reaction gifs are not allowed as posts

  2. All posted content must be related to the Civilization series, Civilization Beyond Earth, Alpha Centauri, or Colonization series and should be original in nature.

  3. If you post a screenshot of the game, please point out what you want people to look at in the image or explain in the comments.

  4. Posts comprised of current leaders or events are not allowed, however, informative posts about past leaders or structures that are included in the series are allowed.

  5. Posts that ask for, link to, or advocate piracy in any way will be removed.

My thoughts are as follows.

  1. Unneeded. If it becomes a shitshow in here at some point, then we can talk. right now, with such a small community, I see no reason to reject content, so long as its relevant

  2. Relevancy is nice, but I would like to reword this to read as being a touch more malleable, right now it seems like an ultimatum.

  3. Sure, I guess

  4. Good rule, once again, might loosen it, and make it clear that drawing connections to the game, even about current events is fine, but that getting political is not.

  5. Seems coolio. Piracy is bad and all that...

That being said, this sub should not be about me, but about the users contributing to it, so I want to hear the thoughts of anyone active, both on my proposed take/ tweaks, and on the original rules, as well as any new proposals that you might consider to be of value.
